items.title: Choose how guests attend
items.body: Create event now asks whether guests join in person with the live stream, or by live stream only. For an in person event, the venue and city show right below.

items.title: Required fields are always visible
items.body: Everything you must fill in sits in the main form, marked with a star. More options holds only optional extras, and the form shows exactly what is missing.

items.title: Max guests has no limit by default
items.body: Leave Max guests empty for no limit. Your country is now filled in from your profile phone number instead of always being Rwanda.

releases.title: Go live from your own event

items.title: Host and go live
items.body: Clients and coordinators can now host an event and go live from the home screen, the same way photographers do, free or paid.

items.title: My hosted events
items.body: A new My hosted events screen lists your upcoming, live and ended events and opens the live studio for each one.

items.title: Create event is simpler
items.body: The create event form no longer has the I stream it myself switch. Tap Go live under the form to host and stream your own event.

items.title: Problems reach us with your support code
items.body: When something goes wrong, the app now sends us a short report that carries the same support code you see on screen, so we can find and fix it quickly.

items.title: Nothing personal is sent
items.body: Reports leave out your name, email, phone number and anything you typed. They only describe what failed and where.

releases.title: Clearer problems when creating an album

items.title: Problems show next to the field
items.body: When the title, price, currency or recipient email needs fixing, the message now appears right under that field, the screen scrolls to it, and everything you typed stays.

items.title: Photo counts read correctly
items.body: The new album screen now says 1 photo instead of 1 photos, and counts the photos it is uploading the same way.

items.title: Plain messages when it does not work
items.body: If creating an album fails for another reason, you now get a short, friendly message with a Try again button and a support code you can read out.

releases.title: Safer amounts when you change currency

items.title: Donation and withdrawal amounts clear when you change currency
items.body: If you switch currency while typing a donation or withdrawal amount, the amount now empties so the same number is never read in a different currency. Type it again in the new one.

items.title: Friendlier messages when something goes wrong
items.body: Behind the scenes we prepared plainer messages with a clear next step for when something does not work. You will start to see them on each screen as we move it over.

releases.title: Price and currency in one field

items.title: One field for the price and its currency
items.body: Pick the currency right inside the price field. The smallest allowed price and its worth in your own currency show underneath as you type.

items.title: Find a currency fast
items.body: Search by code, name or country, and see the currencies you use most at the top.

releases.title: Prices checked in your own currency

items.title: The right minimum for each currency
items.body: When you price an album or a live stream, the form now shows the smallest price for the currency you picked, so a price like USD 4 is no longer refused as too low.

items.title: Cents where they exist
items.body: You can type cents in currencies that have them. Rwandan, Ugandan and CFA francs stay whole numbers.

releases.title: Invite someone to help run your business

items.title: Workspace collaborators
items.body: You can now invite a supporter or a friend to help run your business with just their email. They set a password from the link, then sign in on the normal login page, and you can remove them at any time.

items.title: Money stays with you
items.body: A collaborator can handle bookings, events, albums, clients and messages, but never sees your wallet, balance, withdrawals or transactions, and analytics show counts without money figures.

items.title: Email me a code instead
items.body: On the sign-in screen you can now ask for a six-digit code by email instead of typing a password, and people who work in more than one workspace can choose which one to open.

items.title: Copy button for the setup key
items.body: When you set up an authenticator app, a Copy key button now puts the setup key on your clipboard, or opens the share sheet with a Copy option, so you can paste it into your app.

items.title: Easier code entry when you sign up or open a free album
items.body: The code box now fills from your messages or a paste and sends itself at the sixth digit. You see how many tries are left and when you can ask for a new code.

items.title: Safer codes
items.body: Too many wrong tries pauses the code for a few minutes, so nobody can guess it.

items.title: Set up two-factor right from a withdrawal
items.body: If two-factor is off when you withdraw, we now take you straight to setting it up, with an authenticator app or an email code, then back to your withdrawal.

items.title: Get your sign-in code by email
items.body: Turn on Email code in Two-factor authentication and we send a 6-digit code to your inbox when you sign in. You can use it instead of, or alongside, an authenticator app.

items.title: Easier code entry
items.body: Codes are one field that fills from your messages or a paste and sends itself at the sixth digit. You always see how many tries are left and when you can ask for a new code.

items.title: Clearer authenticator setup
items.body: The setup key is now grouped in fours and can be selected, so it is easy to read and type.

items.title: No more selfie to withdraw
items.body: Withdrawals no longer ask for a selfie. We email a 6-digit code to your account and you enter it to confirm.

items.title: Send a new code any time
items.body: If the code does not arrive or runs out, tap Send a new code to my email on the confirm step and enter the fresh one.

releases.title: Balances that show they are updating

items.title: Loading shows when amounts are hidden
items.body: Wallet balances and revenue now show a short loading mark every 10 seconds as they refresh, even when your amounts are hidden.

items.title: Revenue and earnings too
items.body: Revenue, earnings, spending and the wallet figures now refresh together, so everything you see stays current.

releases.title: Fix for event creation in coordinator dashboard

items.title: Event creation fixed
items.body: Fixed an issue where tapping the Create event button in the event coordinator dashboard would not submit when optional location details were omitted.

items.title: See what is archived
items.body: If one of your albums was archived, you now see a clear notice on it. You keep your photos, and the notice tells you how to restore it on the Connekyt website so clients and buyers can open it again.
